method: Native six-charge ordinary district, high quality, 1440x900, DPR 1, muted. No evidence recording, Astra tests or encoding ran during native timing measurements. Active interval is wall seconds 0.5–6; late interval is 18–24. All RAF intervals, simulation advancement, end counts and observed external processes are retained. The FINAL comparison is indexed-contact (a1c75de) versus solid-contact-pair (2a8f4ae), both with 16 unrelated verification workers observed. The earlier final and corrected-final-pair labels refer to the superseded 0799b75-versus-4cebb5d comparison, which began after the then-observed workers ended. Earlier traces are diagnostic history, not final-runtime measurements. Differing variable-step ruins and external CPU contention limit absolute comparisons.
